needed.evidence: A grassy, sloping embankment rises directly from the road edge with no path or pavement for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, level footway on the left side, separated from the carriageway by a kerb and a buffer strip.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is a narrow, unpaved shoulder leading to a grass verge and buildings, with no dedicated pedestrian path.
needed.suggestion: Install a purpose-built footway on the right side to provide a safe, separated route for pedestrians.

needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users.
